about: Tom's binding contract. The keys come only from the model (model::fighter_bindings_with, model::pad_bindings, service::any_map::menu_bindings); this file maps each action label there to the Smashcraft action its key must reach, in the map's standard keys and in Tom's saved bindings (tom-saved-bindings.pld, copied read-only from his CustomMapData). src/service/any_map.rs checks both.
rules: LT and RT both shield; RT presses its own key, so a press while LT is held is a fresh right-trigger press.
Start starts the match regardless of cursor position: it presses the Y key on every screen and never clicks.
